script_text: Gemini, this week the cosmos is pulling you into the spotlight, and how you handle the pressure will define your month. Early on, Mercury, your ruling air planet, squares Mars in your 7th House of partnerships, creating friction in romantic and business relationships on Monday and Tuesday. However, Wednesday brings a welcome relief as Venus trines your 10th House of career, smoothing over professional hurdles and attracting recognition. The key mid-week shift occurs as Jupiter aligns with your 3rd House of communication, opening powerful doors for your creative ideas and projects. By Thursday, the planetary focus shifts to your 5th House of romance, warming your personal life and bringing joyful social connections. Wednesday is your power day because Venus elevates your career, while Tuesday is your worst day due to the Mercury-Mars square. Focus on speaking with empathy to preserve harmony. Follow for daily updates.
